title: Job Union Scraper Input
description: Unified input schema that drives both the Google Jobs Scraper (johnvc/Google-Jobs-Scraper) and the LinkedIn Job Search actor (harvestapi/linkedin-job-search). Fields are grouped by scope: orchestration, shared search, Google-specific, and LinkedIn-specific.

sources.title: Sources to scrape
sources.description: Which job platforms to query. Selecting both runs them in parallel.

deduplicateResults.title: Deduplicate results
deduplicateResults.description: When true, jobs that appear in both sources (matched by title + company + location) are merged into a single record carrying data from both sources.

outputNormalised.title: Output normalised schema
outputNormalised.description: When true, every job is emitted using the common normalised schema regardless of source. When false, the raw source payload is preserved alongside the _source and _normalisedAt fields.

query.title: Job search query
query.description: Primary search query sent to BOTH Google Jobs and LinkedIn (as the first / only jobTitle). Examples: 'Software Engineer', 'Data Scientist', 'Product Manager'.

location.title: Job location
location.description: Primary location sent to BOTH sources. Recommended to specify at city level for best results. For LinkedIn, this becomes the first entry in the locations list.

googleConfig.title: Google Jobs configuration
googleConfig.description: All settings specific to the Google Jobs Scraper (johnvc/Google-Jobs-Scraper). These are ignored when Google is not in 'sources'.

country.title: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
country.description: E.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'. Leave empty (None) to let Google infer from domain.

language.title: Language code
language.description: Language for Google results. Defaults to 'None' (Google infers).

google_domain.title: Google domain
google_domain.description: Which regional Google domain to query. Defaults to google.com.

num_results.title: Maximum number of results
num_results.description: Maximum Google job records to return. Defaults to 100.

max_pagination.title: Maximum pages
max_pagination.description: Maximum pages to paginate (~10 results each). Set to 0 for unlimited.

lrad_value.title: Location radius (km)
lrad_value.description: Radius in km when include_lrad is true. E.g. '5', '10', '25'.

max_delay.title: Request delay (seconds)
max_delay.description: Pause between Google API requests to avoid rate limiting.

linkedInConfig.title: LinkedIn Jobs configuration
linkedInConfig.description: All settings specific to the LinkedIn Job Search actor (harvestapi/linkedin-job-search). These are ignored when LinkedIn is not in 'sources'.

extraJobTitles.title: Additional job title queries
extraJobTitles.description: Extra search queries run on LinkedIn on top of the shared 'query' field. Supports LinkedIn boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT).

extraLocations.title: Additional locations
extraLocations.description: Extra LinkedIn location strings appended to the shared 'location'. LinkedIn uses its own autocomplete — use full names like 'United Kingdom' rather than 'UK'.

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max jobs per query × location combination
maxItemsPerQuery.description: LinkedIn scraper runs once per (jobTitle × location) pair; this caps how many jobs each pair returns.

company.title: Company filter
company.description: Filter to specific companies. Accepts LinkedIn company page URLs or plain company names.

workplaceType.title: Workplace type
workplaceType.description: Filter by one or more workplace types.

employmentType.title: Employment type
employmentType.description: Filter by one or more employment types.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Filter by one or more experience levels.

salary.title: Salary filter
salary.description: Filter by salary ranges (LinkedIn predefined brackets).

under10Applicants.title: Under 10 applicants
under10Applicants.description: Only return jobs with fewer than 10 applicants.

easyApply.title: LinkedIn Easy Apply only
easyApply.description: Only return jobs with the LinkedIn Easy Apply option.

postedLimit.title: Posted within
postedLimit.description: Filter to jobs posted in the last 1 hour, 24 hours, week, or month.

sortBy.title: Sort results by
sortBy.description: Sort LinkedIn results by relevance or date.

industryIds.title: Industry IDs
industryIds.description: LinkedIn industry IDs to filter by. Full list: https://github.com/HarvestAPI/linkedin-industry-codes-v2

geoIds.title: Geo IDs
geoIds.description: LinkedIn geo IDs for precise region targeting. E.g. 103644278 for USA.

startPage.title: Start page
startPage.description: Page number to start scraping from. Each page has 25 results.

cookie.title: LinkedIn session cookie
cookie.description: Optional: your LinkedIn cookies (exported via Cookie-Editor). Improves reliability for authenticated results.

userAgent.title: User agent override
userAgent.description: Optional: custom User-Agent string. Copy from https://www.whatismybrowser.com/detect/what-is-my-user-agent/

proxy.title: Proxy URL
proxy.description: Optional: custom proxy URL. Overrides the actor's default proxy. Recommended: residential proxy for reliability.
